recap.text: Armed men from Africa get a name on a broadcast with a graphic counting their ammunition. A city boss kills every one of them except a single man locked outside the boss room. The remaining-crawler count drops below a million in the same broadcast.

beats.headline: Named on the recap
beats.text: The armed men from Africa get a name on the broadcast, and a graphic counting what is left of their ammunition.
beats.gist: Armed men from Africa get a name and an ammunition counter graphic on the broadcast.

beats.headline: Wiped
beats.text: Another recap carries the news: a city boss kills every one of them except a single man locked outside the boss room, and the remaining-crawler count drops below a million in the same broadcast.
beats.gist: A city boss kills all Le Mouvement members except one man locked outside the boss room.
